About the Scholarship

The University of Toronto offers admission awards to entering international undergraduates, from automatic merit scholarships to named competitive awards. Applicants are assessed during the admission process, and the university's Award Explorer lists each award's value, criteria and any separate deadline.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

The University of Toronto offers admission awards to entering international undergraduates, from automatic merit scholarships to named competitive awards. Applicants are assessed during the admission process, and the university's Award Explorer lists each award's value, criteria and any separate deadline.

Programme Highlights

  • Mix of automatic and application-based entrance awards
  • Award Explorer tool lists value, criteria and deadlines
  • Available across U of T's three campuses
  • Undergraduate focus — most awards need no separate form

Who Should Apply

International applicants entering first-entry undergraduate programmes at U of T, judged on admission-file strength; some named awards require nomination or essays.

Funding and Costs

Entrance awards from partial tuition credits to full packages, depending on the specific award. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply for admission first, then consult the Award Explorer and the admission-awards page for any award with a separate deadline. Key deadline information: Awarded with admission — individual award deadlines vary; see the U of T Award Explorer.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About University of Toronto

University of Toronto is a public research university in Ontario, Canada. It offers undergraduate, graduate and professional education across science, engineering, medicine, business, humanities and social sciences. Its campuses and research institutes support academic inquiry and international collaboration, connecting students and researchers with questions spanning scientific discovery and contemporary society.

Official website: https://www.utoronto.ca/

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Awarded with admission - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
